## Independence and exact final scope

This is a fresh final whole-change assessment of eab1f8041f076312737ac1466a78c9a8de639445 through a0a59c660cea5f062dba93090ed350f8eeac2157, including all delivered engineering and cross-milestone interactions. The independent reviewer authored none of the proposal, Design, plan, implementation or tests. Its prior participation was assessment and original-reporter finding resolution only. Prior milestone approvals inform the inspected history but do not substitute for this integrated judgment. No engineering, upstream artifact, activity or work state is changed by the reviewer.

Primary context confirms completed M1–M4 and all registered findings resolved. Current direction is Proposal r6; Design r5 owns the exact Release/System/Design/scoped R7-R8 package; Delivery r2 approves the exact unchanged primary plan a9604c2e49e78193c40b538023af54b791623ae9ecb0cb56d551a1f07af87985. The final engineering tree is unchanged since a0a59c66; later working-tree edits are attributable route/evidence/Proposal-r6/M4-review records. Those are inspected in their current form without pretending they were in the earlier engineering commit. Exact current subjects are stored above; deleted-original identities and absence remain in M4 evidence and the immutable Git range.

## Fresh complete-change and interaction assessment

Fresh reads covered the whole engineering file list and diff, source/contract/plan/navigation transfer, prepare/preflight/full verifier changes, actual candidate construction and package consumers, retained ZIP and provider authority, execute/recovery/reporting/optional mirror, CLI/YAML environment/outputs and test/selector composition. Particular final questions were whether later helper/configuration changes invalidated old candidate proof, whether real provider bytes were linked to approval before writes, whether uncertain outcomes and reporting failure survived hosted restoration, and whether source removal left a current owner or runtime dependency missing. No unresolved material defect was found.

M1 preparation identifies exact reviewed S, produces only allowlisted generated C, verifies source/check implementation identity, then builds archives and archive-derived bundled metadata/index before npm packing. Outer evidence binds C, overlay, tarball and all retained inputs without self-referential hashing. Full verification is reached through release-verify.sh prepared-candidate mode and runs actual existing skill/adapter/npm/security/metadata checks plus real packed version/all-target init. Pending public expectations remain separate from actual local receipts. Human narrative and finalized historical fields remain preserved.

M2/M3 connect those exact bytes to immutable provider-artifact metadata and physical ZIP digest/member identities before publication. Setup inspection, exact run/source/environment approval and current tool/configuration checks are separate from recording labels. One protected executor follows read-only preparation; the old unguarded tag route is absent. Runtime credentials are checked before public writes; retained tarball publication uses OIDC/provenance without token fallback or lifecycle repacking. Remote setup remains a real external prerequisite, not a claim made by YAML or tests.

At each public boundary, definite absence permits the authorized missing operation, a matching identity is observed without duplicate publication, conflict stops without overwrite, and unknown/lost/timeout outcome retains uncertainty until observed. Git CAS excludes competing active attempts and preserves unrelated evidence. Actual registry/archive identity and fresh installed target trees precede completed closeout. Failed smoke/reporting remains incomplete; hosted retry restores the original candidate and validated append-only observations before fresh authority/public checks. Prior failed-reporting events survive restoration. Optional mirroring archives the exact completed evidence commit, checks existing named bytes, never clobbers, and reports unavailability independently. It does not change candidate inputs or recurse into its own digest.

M4 removes exactly the six specified prose sources and selected mixed-architecture standing paragraphs/navigation. The living Release model retains actionable requirements/populations, operational syntax, representative proof intent and decisions; historical lifecycle/rollout obligations have explicit supersession. Three adapter/history paragraphs, public npm flow, diagrams, literal baseline and activation inventory remain unchanged. No code/package/resource/check/configuration is changed by retirement. FU013 retains Distribution/Installation ownership and next action. Proposal r6, Design r5 and Delivery r2 explicitly support current replacement reliance; old judgments remain original, and the earlier M4 Proposal-r5 overstatement remains disclosed as corrected later, not retroactively true.

## Evidence applicability and executed checks

The final authoritative proof is release-final-range-ci-r1: `bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base eab1f8041f076312737ac1466a78c9a8de639445 --head a0a59c660cea5f062dba93090ed350f8eeac2157` passed exit0 at /tmp/release-final-ci.log. All15 selected checks executed successfully: record_store.schema, model.validate, boundary_first.validate/regression, skills.regression, adapters.regression/drift/validate, artifact_lifecycle.validate, change_metadata.regression/validate, release_transaction.regression, guide_system.validate, selector.regression and rigorloop_cli.test. Actual release regression took127.84s, deletion-aware lifecycle115.26s, selector59.79s and CLI23.78s; boundary total13.50s and focused384.40s. The inspected selector reports broad_smoke.required=false with sources[]; this is an actual applicability result, not a waived required broad check. No engineering changed during the run.

Older M1/M2 code and candidate identities are historical observations: later M3 composition changed script/tool/configuration inputs, so their old receipts alone cannot establish final execution. The final full-range release regression rebuilds from current scripts/workflow and exercises the real full verifier/actual candidate and CLI path after the six removals. That current proof supplies runtime applicability; earlier milestone tests explain regression intent and findings, not a substitute stale pass. M4 changes no executable/package inputs, and final deletion-aware checks establish the current reader result. Current archive/package metadata inputs outside the temporary candidate are unaffected; temporary proof regenerates the candidate with owning builders.

Reviewer direct checks in the preserved final engineering state include actual coordination12 tests passed2.674s, executor24 tests passed38.541s before unchanged M3 additions to its provider, actual materialization/duplicate/symlink ZIP rejection, exact six deletion and retained-byte/diagram assertions, current consumer search and current scoped context/subject inspection. These direct observations supplement the fresh final15-check run rather than claim independently rerunning every suite. No needless additional full test repetition is selected after unchanged final proof passes. Record-store validation and diff checks follow this review save and establish storage/whitespace only.

Earlier red regression runs, M4 explicit-path missing-source failure and its successful revision-bound replacement remain recorded; none was relabeled as success. Current documentation checks passed with their disclosed readability advisories, not a numeric simplification claim. The real external services and hosted runner are substituted in fixture proof; no hosted CI success, npm/GitHub publication, customer installation, configured reviewer protection or production timing measurement is asserted.

## Handoff

Final whole-change Code Review is approved with no new findings.
